# Unpatentable.org

> > An AI-powered invention engine publishing free, open technologies to humanity, advancing patent reform and democratizing innovation across all scientific domains.

Unpatentable.org is a platform dedicated to open innovation and patent alternatives, publishing cutting-edge research and technologies across 11 major domains—from AI and biotechnology to energy and space exploration. The site champions patent-free invention publishing, intellectual property reform, and collaborative research models that prioritize public benefit over proprietary control.

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://unpatentable.org): AI invention engine platform publishing free technologies to humanity
- [About](http://unpatentable.org/about): Mission statement on open innovation, patent reform, and public domain
- [Innovations](https://unpatentable.org/innovation): Library of open innovations across multiple technology domains

## Innovation Domains

- [Digital & Information Technologies](https://unpatentable.org/domains/digital-information-technologies): Domain hub for AI, machine learning, cybersecurity, and data analytics
- [Transportation & Mobility](https://unpatentable.org/domains/transportation-mobility): Domain hub for EVs, autonomous systems, fuel cells, and propulsion tech
- [Life Sciences & Biotechnology](https://unpatentable.org/domains/life-sciences-biotechnology): Domain hub for biotech, 3D bioprinting, aging, and agricultural innovation
- [Energy & Environmental Technology](https://unpatentable.org/domains/energy-environmental-technologies): Domain hub for clean energy, sustainability, and climate solutions
- [Manufacturing & Robotics](https://unpatentable.org/domains/manufacturing-robotics): Domain hub for additive manufacturing, automation, and industrial robotics
- [Physical Science & Materials](https://unpatentable.org/domains/physical-sciences-materials): Domain hub for advanced materials, quantum tech, and chemistry innovations
- [Space & Aerospace](https://unpatentable.org/domains/space-aerospace): Domain hub for propulsion, satellite operations, and space exploration
- [Construction & Infrastructure](https://unpatentable.org/domains/construction-infrastructure): Domain hub for 3D printing, BIM, building materials, and construction robotics
- [Agriculture & Food Systems](https://unpatentable.org/domains/agriculture-food-systems): Domain hub for sustainable farming, food security, and agricultural robotics
- [Human Centered Technologies](https://unpatentable.org/domains/human-centered-technologies): Domain hub for assistive tech, wearables, BCIs, and accessibility innovation

## Research & Thought Leadership

- [The Race](http://unpatentable.org/the-race): Patent reform narrative comparing historical innovations and open-source models
- [Collisions of Mind: Toward System-Level Superintelligence Beyond Distributional Bounds](https://unpatentable.org/collisions-of-mind-toward-system-level-superintelligence-beyond-distributional-bounds): Research on LLM limitations and emergent multi-agent AI reasoning systems

## Specialized Domains

- [Digital Media & Entertainment](https://unpatentable.org/domains/digital-media-entertainment): Domain hub for VR, gaming, content creation, and open media technologies
- [Social & Organizational Systems](https://unpatentable.org/domains/social-organizational-systems): Domain hub for governance, collaborative platforms, and finance innovation
